newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil mixed at close, volume down.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil mixed at close, volume down.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - The market ended lower on liquidation after drifting in tight ranges, with news of a U.S. missile to Iraq having no impact on market. More liquidation was seen after recent strong gains. Lack of fresh tenders also eased prices. Support level for Nov futures will be 1,230.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices held steady on some covering, and confined to nearby CPOs.
The closure of the Chicago soyoil market yesterday also limited activity, they said. Trading on the futures market fell to 1,879 lots from 3,099 lots on Monday.
Despite the fall today, players were divided over the market's trend in near-term. Some felt that the market undertone was firm due to supportive fundamentals.
Caleb Brett said August exports were 715,550 tonnes compared with 667,802 tonnes in July, and SGS put exports at 708,601 tonnes against July's 649,331 tonnes.
Others traders said that the market needs a technical correction after recent gains.

Falls were marginal at the close. November futures ended five ringgit lower at 1,244 ringgit ($498.40) a tonne after trading between 1,232 and 1,256 ringgit. The contract support level was 1,230 with resistance at 1,270.
There were more selling when November futures dropped below the 1,250 ringgit level.
Physicals saw interest among nearby CPOs with Sept (south) crude palm oil quoting sellers at 1,260 ringgit a tonne after trading from 1,260 and 1,250. Sept (south) saw bids at 1,255.
Sept (central) was offered at 1,250 with bids at 1,245. Sept (north) saw offers at 1,235 and bids at 1,225.
Oct/Nov/Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,270 ringgit with bids at 1,260. Oct (central) saw offers at 1,255 and bids at 1,245 and Nov (central) at 1,260 with bids at 1,250.
In refined products, Sept RBD palmoil was offered at $540 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Oct/Nov/Dec at $537.50.
Sept palm olein saw offers at $580, Oct at $572.50 and Nov/Dec at $562.50. Nov/Dec was traded at $560.
Sept RBD palm stearin was offered at $420, Oct at $425 and Sept/Oct palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $340. --Tan Lee Lee (603-2308911) ($1=2.4960 ringgit)
